card.name: Inside the abbreviation USP
card.fires_on: The letter P in US-P, or the characters right after USP (such as -NF, a space or <797>), in pharmacy and storage statements. It marks the point where the model has just read the US Pharmacopeia abbreviation.

modes.label: P in USP
modes.description: The final letter of US-P when the text refers to USP storage or temperature standards.

modes.label: After USP
modes.description: The -NF letters or the space and number following USP in compounding or diluent wording.

card.writes: It slightly promotes fluid-related words such as 'fluid' and 'inject', which fits infusion and diluent text.
card.plain: It fires when the text spells out the USP pharmacopeia standard, often in storage or preparation instructions.
